question: Should ClawHub add a first-class SKILL.md capability manifest for skills, and what schema, authority model, and advisory-to-required rollout should it use?
rationale: This changes ClawHub's public skill trust boundary and security contract; source inspection can verify it is not implemented, but automation should not choose the permanent capability taxonomy or rollout policy.

options.title: Adopt Advisory Manifest First
options.body: Define the schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-versus-observed mismatches before making it required.

options.title: Defer To Scanner Inference
options.body: Keep using env/install metadata plus ClawScan coherence review, accepting that there is still no author-declared baseline for network, filesystem, execution, or secret access.

options.title: Require Manifests Immediately
options.body: Require new skill submissions to provide the capability block from day one, which gives a stronger contract but needs sharper legacy and false-positive policy first.

recommendation.title: Adopt Advisory Manifest First
recommendation.body: Define the schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-versus-observed mismatches before making it required.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest individual routing signal from CODEOWNERS and blame for the affected schema, parser, scanner, and security-doc paths.
